WHO I AM I spent more than 25 years as a high school teacher in Wauwatosa. In my time away from the classroom I served many people in the Milwaukee Metro area with their home repair needs. That service has lead me to the point where just about anything that needs fixing or improvement with your home I can do. Now that I am retired from teaching I have expanded this business. Got a job you don't have time for or an improvement you'd like to make? Give me a call you won't find a more honest or reasonably priced handyman in the area.
